Your opponent cannot select any Dragon-Type monsters as the target(s) of Spell, Trap, or Monster Card effects. Once per turn, you can Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type monster from your hand."

name: Meteor of Destruction

name: Swords of Concealing Light
extDescription: When you activate this card, change all monsters on your opponent's side of the field to face-down Defense Position. Monsters on your opponent's side of the field cannot change their Battle Positions. Destroy this card during your 2nd Standby Phase after activation.

name: Spiral Spear Strike
extDescription: When "Gaia the Fierce Knight", "Swift Gaia the Fierce Knight" or "Gaia the Dragon Champion" you control attacks a Defense Position monster, if the ATK of that card is higher than the DEF of the Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent. If "Gaia the Dragon Champion" inflicts Battle Damage with this effect, draw 2 cards and discard 1 card.

name: Release Restraint
extDescription: Tribute 1 "Gearfried the Iron Knight" to Special Summon 1 "Gearfried the Swordmaster" from your hand or Deck.

name: Centrifugal Field

name: Fulfillment of the Contract
extDescription: Pay 800 Life Points. Select 1 Ritual Monster from your Graveyard, Special Summon it, and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, remove the equipped monster from play.

name: Re-Fusion

name: The Big March of Animals

name: Cross Counter
extDescription: If the DEF of an attacked Defense Position monster is higher than the ATK of your opponent's attacking monster, the Battle Damage inflicted to your opponent is doubled. Destroy the attacking monster after damage calculation.

name: Pole Position
extDescription: The face-up monster(s) with the highest ATK on the field is unaffected by any Spell Cards. When "Pole Position" is removed from the field, destroy the face-up monster(s) with the highest ATK on the field.

name: Penalty Game!
extDescription:
"When your opponent has 4 cards in their hand, select and activate 1 of the these effects:
- Your opponent cannot draw during their next Draw Phase.
- Your opponent cannot activate any Spell or Trap Cards this turn."

name: Beast Soul Swap

name: Deck Devastation Virus

name: Elemental Burst

name: Elemental Hero Clayman
extDescription: An Elemental Hero with a clay body built-to-last. He will preserve his Elemental Hero colleagues at any cost.

name: Elemental Hero Sparkman
extDescription: An Elemental Hero and a warrior of light who proficiently wields many kinds of armaments. His Shining Surge Flash cuts off the path of villainy.

extDescription: If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell or Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step.

name: Hieracosphinx

extDescription: Once per turn, you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned, return 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field to its owner's hand.
